## Intent / 目的

## Acceptance criteria / 验收标准

## Engineering risks / 工程风险
- [ ] API/schema/permission/data changes identified
- [ ] Rollback path documented if needed

## Verification evidence / 验证结果
- Commands actually run:

- [ ] Pass B: maintainability, scope and tests

## Source and policy changes / 标准更新
- Evidence URL and observation date:
- Independent approval required: Yes / No
